messages:
ivy: quick smoke on cust Crestline's LoRA merge (redwood-3b + int4). invoice extractor F1 down ~3.6%. seeing currency token splitting (e.g., 'C$2,450' -> ['C','$','2',',','450']).
jay: can you paste the eval command and an anonymized failing case?
ivy: ran: ```bash
ri-cli eval run --model redwood-3b:int4 --adapter crestline-lora --evalpack crestline/invoices-mini --batch 24 --timeout 300
```
example:
INPUT: "Invoice: C$2,450.00 due 2025-06-15."
GOLD: {"total":"2450.00","currency":"CAD","due":"2025-06-15"}
PRED: {"total":"2","currency":"C","due":"06/15"}  <-- tokenizer split + parser mismatch
ci-bot: run 720123-01 finished. metrics: extraction_f1:0.864 (baseline 0.900), exact_match:0.748. token_split_count:7/140. logs: s3://ri-logs/7201234567/720123-01.log
nora: likely cause: adapter trained with locale-specific merges (single token for 'C$'). adapter includes token_map but loader ignores it unless aliasing is enabled.
jay: short-term options: enable adapter.token_aliases, add postprocess merge in parser, or ask for re-export with canonical tokenizer. fastest = aliasing.
ivy: agreed. nora, can you add an alias loader and run a heat test? simple mapping: {"CAD_SYM":"C$","USD_SYM":"$"} and flag adapter.token_aliases=true.
ci-bot: job queued 720123-02 by nora: ```bash
ri-cli eval run --model redwood-3b:int4 --adapter crestline-lora --evalpack crestline/invoices-mini --config adapter.token_aliases=true --batch 24
```
ci-bot: job 720123-02 complete. metrics: extraction_f1:0.897 (+0.033), exact_match:0.775 (+0.027). token_split_count:1/140. artifacts: s3://ri-logs/7201234567/720123-02.log
jay: nice. please add a tiny tokenizer-split assertion to the evalpack (20 examples across en_CA/en_US/en_GB) and telemetry when aliasing is used.
ivy: will do. plan: (1) enable adapter.token_aliases for Crestline in int4 routes, (2) add tokenizer test in evalpack, (3) schedule re-export guidance for customer. tagging @oncall for a short config flip window. thanks all :thumbsup:
